metadata.question: Does the vegetation cover in Robinson Crusoe Island show higher greenness compared to Santa Clara Island in November 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare vegetation greenness (NDVI) between Robinson Crusoe Island and Santa Clara Island - Both are part of Juan Fernández Islands, Chile (~33.6°S, 78.8°W) - Date: November 2018 - Use Sentinel-2 for better resolution, fallback to Landsat 8 if needed 2. Masking strategy: - This is about vegetation greenness, not clouds - Should mask clouds to get accurate NDVI readings - Use cloud probability or QA bands 3. Logic to distinguish: - Valid Zero: NDVI can be legitimately low (0-0.2) for bare soil/water - Need to check: collection size > 0, valid pixels > 0, NDVI in valid range (-1 to 1) - Compare mean NDVI between the two islands - Robinson Crusoe higher greenness → A, otherwise → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for both islands // Robinson Crusoe Island (main island, larger) const robinsonCrusoe = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.85, -33.64]); // Santa Clara Island (small islet to the southwest) const santaClara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.97, -33.69]); const startDate = '2018-11-01'; const endDate = '2018-11-30'; // 2. Try Sentinel-2 first let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(robinsonCrusoe) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(santaClara) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Robinson Crusoe S2 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Santa Clara S2 images: ${size2}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 fails if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('Trying Landsat 8 fallback...'); col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(robinsonCrusoe) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(santaClara) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); const l8size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const l8size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Robinson Crusoe L8 images: ${l8size1}`); console.log(`Santa Clara L8 images: ${l8size2}`); if (l8size1 === 0 || l8size2 === 0) { console.log('No images available for one or both locations'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Cloud masking and NDVI calculation function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask) .normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } function maskL8clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask) .normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI'); } let ndvi1, ndvi2; if (size1 > 0) { ndvi1 = col1.map(maskS2clouds).median(); ndvi2 = col2.map(maskS2clouds).median(); } else { ndvi1 = col1.map(maskL8clouds).median(); ndvi2 = col2.map(maskL8clouds).median(); } // 4. Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const buffer1 = robinsonCrusoe.buffer(1000); const buffer2 = santaClara.buffer(500); const stats1 = await ndvi1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer1, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await ndvi2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: buffer2, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.NDVI_mean; const count1 = stats1.NDVI_count; const mean2 = stats2.NDVI_mean; const count2 = stats2.NDVI_count; console.log(`Robinson Crusoe: NDVI=${mean1?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Santa Clara: NDVI=${mean2?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation and answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after cloud masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2) || mean1 < -1 || mean1 > 1 || mean2 < -1 || mean2 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values calculated'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (mean1 > mean2) { console.log('Robinson Crusoe shows higher greenness'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Robinson Crusoe does not show higher greenness'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
